notes: Runtime versions are unchanged. npm audit covers development dependencies; vendored artifacts require separate upstream advisory review. AnyAscii uses the existing joined classic-script wrapper.

advisoryReview.result: Upstream repository security pages showed no published advisories on the review date. This is not a complete transitive-package audit.

GHSA-h5cx-hfj5-x8v3 (CVE-2025-69993) describes raw HTML passed to bindPopup. The advisory is unreviewed and lists no known patched version. Leaflet documents string content as HTML. Herald keeps its escaped popup templates: journey-presentation.js escapes record text and validates artwork URLs; journey-map.js uses those builders; road-trip-planner.js escapes stop text. No runtime library upgrade or generic sanitiser was introduced in this scoped release. Re-review when changing any popup builder.
Version/provenance and local checksum recorded. Upstream security page could not be retrieved during this review, so no absence-of-advisories claim is made.
